body:
Someone brings the unworkable policy to the meeting as an agenda item instead of a resentment.

Because the objection arrives in proper form, the people who run the structure actually bend it.

With Saturn sextile Lilith, the people who respect process and precedent get to hear from a refusal that never used either.

The door is procedural and it is open, but somebody still has to file the paperwork.

The policy may survive mostly intact, but a refusal that gets representation stops needing sabotage.
